outputs.location: Section titled 'Data Availability', located immediately after the 'Study approval' subsection of the Methods.
outputs.issues: The DAS is a single sentence stating data are available on reasonable request rather than listing deposited datasets in the required bullet-point format. The Methods state that proteomics raw data were deposited in jPOST (jPOST ID: JPST003458/PXD057714) but this deposition is not mentioned in the DAS (inconsistency). No separate bullet points describe data types (e.g., proteomics, ribosome profiling, LC–MS, RNA-seq), repository names, accession numbers/DOIs, and resolvable links as required. If the authors truly have no externally deposited data, the DAS should state exactly: 'This study includes no data deposited in external repositories.'
